## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Tier 1 surgical frozen section with model consensus [F1], severity-3 stain degradation, and all margins called positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 99%, InSitu 1%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%) | Strong calibrated invasive score |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% target coverage (alpha 10%, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 86th OOD percentile, 12/12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC despite stain degradation |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (86%–89% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu (84%) | Unanimous nearest-neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Below-typical score (-0.33, contribution +0.76) [F2]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.17, contribution +0.72) [F3]; 19/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Scarce lobules (-0.13, contribution +0.63) [F4]; unreliable 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 9) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+1.47, contribution +0.55); 18/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low text score (-0.02, contribution +0.33), caption-inconsistent; 18/20 spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing 3 top-risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven classifier faithfulness (deletion CI includes 0: -0.0088 to +0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 stain degradation on this simulated frozen section distorts morphology (reliability error AUROC 70%; stain orders blocked).
- Lesion mimics 84%-similar InSitu contrast case BACH_0013 via duct confinement (12/20 Weak) and benign stroma in region 11.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 1, 5, 6, 9**: Confirm stromal invasion and nuclear pleomorphism in highest-risk regions (80%–99% risk).
2. **Region 11**: Evaluate duct-confined atypia and benign stroma to exclude in situ carcinoma.
3. **Regions 0–3, 4, 7, 8–11**: Verify tumor at superior, inferior, medial, and lateral margins (215–538 um).
